method.zh: 仅依据论文、官方清单和代码核验合集成员。游戏、适配环境、实验任务和媒体来源分别标注；完整性只针对说明中的来源范围，不表示任务协议、运行结果或能力覆盖已核验。
method.en: Collection membership is checked against papers, official manifests and code. Games, adapted environments, experimental tasks and media sources remain distinct. Completeness refers only to the declared source scope, not task protocols, execution results or capability coverage.

records.noteZh: 已核对正文、完整附录、官方项目、代码与数据集说明；评测仅公开十款商业游戏的类别与30项任务，未找到可核验的十款名称清单。训练视频标签不能替代评测游戏清单，继续保留套件归属。
records.noteEn: Full paper, appendices, project, code and dataset card were checked; the ten evaluation titles remain undisclosed in the inspected material. Training-video labels are not used as evaluation membership.
